title.zh-TW: 被毒蛇咬、醫師沒打血清
title.en: The snakebite and the doctor who omits antivenom

subtitle.zh-TW: 醫師有義務施打血清卻沒打；他的不作為是不是死因？
subtitle.en: The doctor is bound to give antivenom and does not; is the omission a cause of the death?

story.zh-TW: 考慮被毒蛇咬傷的病人。小明被毒蛇咬到，被送去急救。負責診治的醫師知道他被蛇咬，也看到中毒症狀，卻沒有為他施打抗毒血清，小明毒發身亡。
story.en: Consider a patient bitten by a snake. Xiao-ming is bitten by a venomous snake and rushed to hospital. The doctor in charge is told of the bite and sees the symptoms of poisoning, but does not give him antivenom, and Xiao-ming dies of the venom.

zh-TW.sentence: 小明被毒蛇咬到，被送去急救。
負責診治的醫師知道他被蛇咬，也看到中毒症狀，卻沒有為他施打抗毒血清，小明毒發身亡。

en.sentence: Xiao-ming is bitten by a venomous snake and rushed to hospital.
The doctor in charge is told of the bite and sees the symptoms of poisoning, but does not give him antivenom, and Xiao-ming dies of the venom.

text.zh-TW: 問小明為什麼死，「因為醫師沒打血清」是自然的答案，醫師也要為此負責。
text.en: Asked why Xiao-ming died, 'because the doctor did not give antivenom' is a natural answer, and the doctor is held answerable.

explanation.zh-TW: 模型取自王一奇與王鵬翔 (2021) 的 Do：A = 1 表示小明被蛇咬，B = 1 表示醫師沒有施打血清（偏差值；B = 0 是打了，是常態），D = 1 表示小明死亡，D = A·B。這個案例和保鏢案例結構相同，兩個反事實依賴都成立：沒被咬或打了血清，小明都不會死。Hitchcock 的區分會把醫師那條視為寄生依賴；王與王指出，醫療常規要求被蛇咬的病人要打血清，所以在這個脈絡裡不打才是偏差，B 到 D 的網絡自足，醫師的不作為是典型原因。引擎的 but-for、HP 修正版與常態版都把蛇咬與不打血清算作原因。
explanation.en: The model is Do of Wang and Wang (2021): A = 1 is the snakebite, B = 1 is the doctor not giving antivenom (the deviant value; B = 0, giving it, is the default), D = 1 is Xiao-ming's death, and D = A·B. The structure is that of the bodyguard case, and both counterfactual dependences hold: without the bite, or with the antivenom, he would not have died. Hitchcock's distinction would class the doctor's route as parasitic dependence; Wang and Wang point out that medical practice requires antivenom for a snakebite, so in this context not giving it is the deviant value, the network from B to D is self-contained, and the omission is a paradigmatic cause. The engine's but-for test and the modified and normality-based HP definitions all count both the bite and the omission as causes.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H., & Wang, L. (2021). Parasitic counterfactual dependence and paradigmatic causation [Jisheng de fanshishi yilai yu dianxing yinguo guanxi; in Chinese]. Journal of Philosophy, National Chengchi University, 45, 39–90.

note.zh-TW: p.57 給出醫師案例；p.58 說明兩個反事實依賴與常規；p.59 給出模型 Do。
note.en: P. 57 states the doctor case; p. 58 gives the two counterfactual dependences and the medical norm; p. 59 gives the model Do.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H. (2019). Problems of hypothetical thinking in causal judgments about omissions [Bu zuowei yinguo panduan zhong de jiashexing sikao wenti; in Chinese]. EurAmerica, 49(3), 287–340.

note.zh-TW: p.322 的〈打錯針的醫師〉是只打了止痛藥的版本。
note.en: P. 322, 'the doctor who gave the wrong injection', is the version in which only a painkiller is given.
